events.trigger_conditions: Stockfish eval delta >= +2.0 or intentional piece sacrifice with ongoing compensation
events.visual_treatment: Piece dissolves into blinding aura; kinetic screen shake; impact sparks
events.animation: Zoom pulse, aura flare, particle shockwave
events.narrative: The legend offers mortal blood to unleash primordial power

events.visual_treatment: Dimensional freeze; rune guillotine descent; boss disintegration
events.audio_treatment: Final orchestral doom hit + ticking clock stop
events.animation: Extreme close-up on King, monochrome flash, red shatter
events.narrative: The sanctuary collapses; the ruler is judged

events.trigger_conditions: Queen captured or surrendered intentionally for tactical win
events.visual_treatment: Supernova screen explosion; full frame chromatic inversion
events.audio_treatment: Muffled silence into titanic bass drop
events.animation: Queen portrait flashes and fragments into golden embers
events.narrative: The ultimate asset surrendered to manifest guaranteed victory

events.trigger_conditions: Single piece simultaneously attacking >= 2 higher or equal value pieces
events.visual_treatment: Split laser targeting beams from attacker to targets
events.animation: Target icons flash red with warning reticles
events.narrative: A solitary blade threatening multiple vital organs at once

events.trigger_conditions: Piece unable to move without exposing King or valuable piece
events.visual_treatment: Runic chains anchoring the pinned piece to the ground
events.audio_treatment: Heavy iron chain rattle and lock
events.animation: Chains wrap around piece sprite; movement locked icon
events.narrative: The enemy's champion is bound by duty, unable to flee

events.trigger_conditions: Attack on high-value piece that forces retreat to expose piece behind
events.visual_treatment: Laser spear passing completely through front target into rear
events.animation: Piercing beam drills through both squares
events.narrative: A strike that pierces the vanguard to bleed the rear guard

events.trigger_conditions: Moving one piece unmasks a line of attack from another
events.visual_treatment: Forward piece shadow slides aside, revealing glowing glyph behind
events.animation: Shadow dodge followed by sudden beam firing
events.narrative: The obvious threat was merely a distraction for the blade in the dark

events.visual_treatment: Golden ascending pillar of light; armor materialization
events.animation: Pawn sprite dissolves into glowing Valkyrie Queen
events.narrative: The foot soldier ascends to godhood upon the final square

events.visual_treatment: Granite fortress walls erupt from the board between King and Rook
events.audio_treatment: Massive stone grinding into place + lock mechanism
events.animation: King glides behind reinforced tower ramparts
events.narrative: The King seals himself behind ancient bastions

events.trigger_conditions: Any legal move by opponent degrades evaluation significantly
events.visual_treatment: Black tendrils constricting all available move squares
events.audio_treatment: Slow suffocation gasps + low discordant drone
events.animation: Square highlights shrink and turn into skull markers
events.narrative: Every choice is death; the dungeon suffocates its prey

events.visual_treatment: Red pulsating border around the board; warning sirens
events.narrative: The enemy's blade grazes the royal throat

events.trigger_conditions: Stockfish eval swing >= -2.5 cp for mover
events.visual_treatment: Armor cracking, glitch artifacting, red exclamation marks
events.audio_treatment: Dull thud + comical or tragic record-scratch / sub drop
events.animation: Piece trips / shivers under immense error highlight
events.narrative: A fatal misstep opens the gate to slaughter

events.trigger_conditions: Eval swings from -3.0 to +1.0 within 5 plies
events.visual_treatment: Phoenix flame burst; darkened screen lights up in gold
events.audio_treatment: Uplifting orchestral battle surge / Phonk drop
events.animation: Hero health bar refills with fiery barrier
events.narrative: Rising from the ashes of impending defeat to seize victory

events.trigger_conditions: Clock time < 30 seconds with intense move density
events.visual_treatment: Red digital countdown timer spinning violently; speed ramp blur
events.animation: Rapid blur trails on every piece glide
events.narrative: The realm collapses in seconds; only instinct survives

events.trigger_conditions: No legal moves and not in check
events.visual_treatment: Time freezes in sepia ice; mutual shield lock
events.animation: Both sides locked in eternal stone stasis
events.narrative: The magic nullifies; neither master claims the soul
